description: Project-level deduction-declaration intake (4b-DDG). One designated ops contact per client/branch/project declares, in writing, whether this period carries any worker deductions. FEEDS - never replaces - the per-worker consent gate: no Salary Slip is built until the declaration is RECEIVED, and silence is NEVER read as clear. A 'clear' declaration must explicitly state no deductions.

fields.description: Optional. Leave blank for a client-wide declaration.
fields.label: Branch Site

fields.description: The ONE designated ops contact for this client/branch/project who declares the period's deductions.
fields.label: Ops Contact

fields.description: Free-text capture of the ops contact's written reply (evidence). NEVER keyword-matched to infer a decision.
fields.label: Declaration Message

fields.description: 1 = the contact EXPLICITLY stated there are no deductions. This is the ONLY way a declaration reads as clear; silence is not clear.
fields.label: No Deductions Explicitly Stated

fields.description: The declared deductions, when the declaration is itemized. Each item still requires its own per-worker consent downstream.
fields.label: Itemized List

fields.description: 1 = the same reply also carried a correction to a prior period; it routes to a correction notice and is never silently folded in.
fields.label: Correction Flagged

fields.description: Slips are held until this is 'received'.
fields.label: Status

name: Deduction Declaration
